location: Title card, white void with a parked sedan

Oversized bold italic lettering dominates the upper two-thirds of the frame; in the lower right, a small boxy 1970s-era blue four-door sedan with chrome bumpers faces right, viewed in three-quarter front profile. action: The driver, now visibly wasted, slurs that he is high; his head doubles in a woozy ghosted blur as the cigarette smoke thickens.

location: Cliff edge over a forested valley, exterior day
action: The blue sedan sails off the edge of a rocky cliff, airborne over a green forest canopy, debris kicking off the cliff lip. 'END' is lettered in the lower right.
visual_prompt: Wide shot, slight low angle. A boxy 1970s-era blue four-door sedan flies fully airborne off a dark craggy cliff edge on the left, nose tipped up, pebbles and dirt scattering behind it, motion streaks tracing its launch arc.
